description: Get a temporary download for a requested file export. For a generated mesh use the primary artifact_id in get_job.mesh_exports (Standard CGNS by default); mesh_cgns is the native Fluxcore/Studio artifact. With command access on the machine where the file belongs, run transfer.command (replace <path>) and check the saved file's SHA-256 equals sha256. Otherwise show a labelled Download file link; the browser saves through the API and the user chooses the destination. A link is not proof of a local save. For design details use read_artifact_summary; for component IDs use inspect_mesh_geometry. Never retry old storage URLs or expired links; request a fresh one. Capabilities are not recorded in MCP audit logs.
name: get_artifact_download
title: Get download link
